Alicia,

Thanks for running through the evaluation with Brian and the team last week. Attached is the MAP v3 (includes the condensed success criteria) and the SOW draft we discussed. The two items I want to lock this week are:

- Final go/no-go signoff date (we need explicit approval to trigger reserved capacity)
- Signature window for DocuSign (to coordinate with our legal/finance)
- Expected customer start date (so we can schedule onboarding engineering slots)

Proposed timeline:
- Nov 10: internal approval from Cartlys (go/no-go)
- Nov 11-12: DocuSign signature window
- Nov 17: Day-one onboarding (tentative - depends on final SOW)

If you can confirm whether Nov 10 works for Cartlys' execs and whether procurement needs a PO or any extra lead time, we can lock dates on our side.

Attachments: Cartlys_MAP_v3.pdf, SOW_cartlys_draft_v2.docx

Thanks,

2) Start date — Nov 17 sounds reasonable but can we make the start date flexible by a week in case of legal redlines?

I can push for the Nov 10 exec check but want to set expectations if procurement needs the extra lead time.

Best,

Alicia and Jordan,

Quick legal input after a skim of the SOW draft:
- We added one protective clause around data handling (section 6.3) that Cartlys' counsel might flag — I attached the annotated PDF (redlines_legal_20261104.pdf).
- Our ask: if Cartlys' legal proposes changes, please send them directly to me so we can accelerate replies. We can generally resolve commercial redlines within 48 hours if both counsels are responsive.
- On start date: Redwood's onboarding team needs a 5-business-day window post-signature to reserve dedicated engineering capacity for committed customers. That would make the earliest feasible start date T+5 business days after signature. If you need Nov 17 as the true day one, we'd need signatures no later than Nov 10 (which is tight).

Suggested operational plan:
1) Nov 5: Redwood sends final clean SOW to Cartlys (Jordan to send)
2) Nov 6–9: Procurement routing at Cartlys
3) Nov 10: Exec sign-off (go/no-go)
4) Nov 11: DocuSign complete (target)
5) Nov 18: Day-one (T+5 business days after 11/11) — or earlier if David (Cartlys procurement) confirms PO expedite.

If you want us to hold a 30-minute legal touchpoint on Nov 6 to pre-check the redlines, I can join.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
